description: This file defines the interface for RDK Window Manager in the WPEFramework, including notification callbacks for application state changes, window creation, key event interception, focus, visibility, and other window management features.

classes.name: IRDKWindowManager
classes.description: Interface for Window Manager functionalities such as creating displays, managing applications, intercepting keys, and handling notifications.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for receiving window and application state change notifications such as focus, visibility, connection, disconnection, and user inactivity.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback interface for window events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback interface.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager with a service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the window manager.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display window with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetApps
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently active application IDs.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercept
methods.description: Sets a key intercept for a specific key code and client.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Sets multiple key intercepts in a single operation.

methods.name: RemoveKeyIntercept
methods.description: Removes a key intercept for a specific key code and client.

methods.name: AddKeyListener
methods.description: Registers listeners for specific key events.

methods.name: RemoveKeyListener
methods.description: Removes specific key event listeners.

methods.name: InjectKey
methods.description: Simulates a key press event with specified key code and modifiers.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Generates a key event for specified keys on a client.

methods.name: EnableInactivityReporting
methods.description: Enables or disables user inactivity reporting.

methods.name: SetInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets the inactivity interval duration.

methods.name: ResetInactivityTime
methods.description: Resets the user inactivity timer.

methods.name: EnableKeyRepeats
methods.description: Enables or disables key repeat functionality.

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: IgnoreKeyInputs
methods.description: Sets whether key inputs are ignored.

methods.name: EnableInputEvents
methods.description: Enables or disables key input events for specified clients.

methods.name: KeyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Configures key repeat behavior with delay and interval settings.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to a specific application by ID.

methods.name: SetVisible
methods.description: Sets visibility status of a client or application instance.

methods.name: RenderReady
methods.description: Checks if the application has rendered its first frame.

methods.name: EnableDisplayRender
methods.description: Enables or disables rendering of a Wayland display.

methods.name: GetLastKeyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the last key event information, including key code, modifiers, and timestamp.

methods.name: void OnBlur(const std::string & appInstanceId)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnConnected(const std::string & appInstanceId)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnDisconnected(const std::string & client)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnFocus(const std::string & appInstanceId)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnHidden(const std::string & appInstanceId)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnReady(const string & client)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnUserInactivity(const double minutes)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void OnVisible(const std::string & appInstanceId)
methods.description: unavailable
